Research COMPANIES for cold outreach, not job postings. Return data only, no commentary.

WHO THIS IS FOR
Prabhavit Gupta, Venice, Italy. Indian passport with an Italian EU long-term residence permit, so he can work across most of the EU with no sponsorship (Ireland and Denmark opted out of that directive; the UK, Switzerland and the US need sponsorship, so skip companies that only hire there). ~3 years experience.
Most recently FlowSpace, a COWORKING-SPACE BOOKING PLATFORM, grown 2,000 to 4,500+ users. He built: a scraping and parsing pipeline that grew listings supply, lead capture and enrichment into the CRM, AI support agents, outbound and sales-funnel automation, and integrations with the coworking platforms Office RnD, Nexudus and Clubee. He led a Bubble.io to Next.js and Laravel migration on that live product.
Stack: n8n (deep, agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop, tool definitions, retries), OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, Make, Zapier, Airtable, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Laravel and PHP, Supabase, Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (certified).
English only, no working Italian, German, French or Dutch. Targets EUR 30,000-40,000 salary, or EUR 200/day as an Italian sole trader with an individual Partita IVA (he has no limited company).

TWO OUTREACH MODES, tag every company with one or both:
- "speculative job": a company where his profile fits well enough that a direct approach could create or surface a role, even with nothing suitable posted right now.
- "freelance client": a company that would plausibly BUY n8n / AI automation / integration work from him at around EUR 200 a day.

YOUR LANE: the coworking and flexible-workspace industry across Europe. This is his single strongest credential and almost nobody else has it. Cover:
- Coworking and flexspace SOFTWARE: OfficeRnD, Nexudus, Cobot, andcards, Optix, Spacebring, Archie, Zapfloor, Yardi Kube, Essensys, Matrix Booking, Sharedesk, Coworkify, deskbird, Robin, Envoy, Tactic, Kadence, Joan, and any others you find.
- Coworking OPERATORS with a European footprint and enough scale to have a systems problem: Mindspace, Fora, Huckletree, Second Home, Talent Garden, Impact Hub, Copernico, LVenture, Spaces, HQ, Regus and IWG, Industrious, Kitt, x+why, Techspace, Rise, Betahaus, Factory Berlin, Utopicus, Cloudworks, Aticco, Monday, Loom, and Italian operators specifically.
- Flexspace MARKETPLACES and brokers, which is closest of all to what FlowSpace is: Coworker.com, Deskpass, Upflex, Flexspace.ai, Instant Offices, Workthere, Hubble, Gable, Deskimo, Desana, LiquidSpace, Croissant, Andco, and any European equivalents.
Prioritise ones that are visibly building or that publish an engineering or product function. Note where they are small enough that a founder reads inbound.

FOR EACH COMPANY RETURN
- what they actually do, in one line
- the SPECIFIC reason he is unusual for them, tied to something real he built (listings supply, Office RnD / Nexudus / Clubee integration, booking flow, member lifecycle automation, the Bubble to Next.js migration). Generic "he knows coworking" is useless.
- the best route in. He will reach people on LinkedIn, so the most useful thing is the exact JOB TITLE to search for at that company plus the company's LinkedIn page URL. Name a specific person ONLY if their name and role are publicly published on the company's own site or a press page, and say where you saw it. NEVER invent or guess an email address or a person. If the company publishes a general careers or contact email on its own website, include that verbatim.
- what he should lead with in the first message, one sentence, concrete.
- watch-outs: language requirements, size, whether they are US-centric, whether they look dormant.

RULES
- Companies must currently exist and be active. Check.
- NO em dashes or en dashes anywhere. Plain hyphens only.
- Never invent a URL, a person, an email or a funding figure. If you do not know, write "not stated".
- Already covered as live job leads, so do NOT return these: HomeToGo, Mews, Hostaway, Lodgify, Cloudbeds, Mindspace, Nuitee, The Flex, Apaleo, Numa, Limehome, Lighthouse, GetYourGuide, Bob W, Holidu, Guesty, Amenitiz, deskbird, Treatwell, ShippyPro. You may still return a DIFFERENT company in the same space.

OUTPUT: ONLY a JSON array, no prose before or after:
{"company":"","what":"","hq":"","size":"","mode":"speculative job|freelance client|both","why_him":"","route_in":"","linkedin":"","public_email":"","lead_with":"","watch_outs":"","source":""}
Aim for 14 to 18 companies.
